items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: the first two blues singers that...I mean, two record...recording singers that I remember of ever hearing were Edith Wilson and Mamie Smith.

ctx.x: Who were some of the first singers you heard? Can you remember any famous blues singers or anyone coming here?
Well, the first two blues singers that...I mean, two record...recording singers that I remember of ever hearing were Edith Wilson and Mamie Smith.
Yeah. What kind of voice did Mamie have in those days? On her old records, it's hard to tell.
